tagline.en_US: Open WebUI on its own, for an Ollama server or an OpenAI-compatible API you already have.

description.en_US: Open WebUI is an extensible, self-hosted user interface designed to run entirely offline. It connects to local large language models through Ollama and supports OpenAI-compatible APIs for both local and cloud models. The platform provides a unified environment to chat with models, manage AI interactions, and run private AI workflows. This version installs Open WebUI only: the models run on an Ollama server or an OpenAI-compatible service set up separately.
